description: This file defines an abstract interface for authentication operations and provides a Firebase-backed implementation for user authentication in a Flutter app. It includes methods for auth state changes, current user retrieval, Google sign-in, and sign-out, integrating Firebase Auth and Google Sign-In packages.

classes.name: IAuthRepository
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for authentication repository, including methods for observing auth state, getting current user, signing in with Google, and signing out.

classes.name: AuthRepository
classes.description: Firebase-backed implementation of IAuthRepository, managing authentication state with FirebaseAuth and GoogleSignIn.

methods.name: authStateChanges
methods.description: Returns a stream emitting current signed-in user as UserModel or null if signed out.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user as UserModel if signed in, otherwise null.

methods.name: signInWithGoogle
methods.description: Performs Google Sign-In flow, returning UserModel of signed-in user, handling both web and mobile platforms.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the user from Firebase and Google accounts.
